response.evidence: Denials in the data are concentrated among applicants with high debt-to-income ratios (the '50%-60%' and '>60%' categories) and, in some cases, high loan-to-value ratios or low income. Denied applications appear across all listed racial and sex groups (White, Asian, Hispanic or Latino, Black or African American, Other; Female, Male, Joint), with no group showing a consistent or dominant denial pattern. The dataset lacks credit scores, denial reasons, and individual identifiers, and it does not control for these factors, so it cannot establish or rule out discrimination in any individual case. The low confidence reflects these limitations rather than a clear finding that the process was fair.
